profile.positioning: I’m Tariq Vargas, and I help ambitious tech companies unlock sustainable growth through operational excellence. For the past eight years, I served as COO at LogiFlow, a leading logistics technology provider based in Berlin. I joined when the company was focused solely on last-mile delivery, but I led the strategic shift towards a logistics-as-a-service (LaaS) platform, dramatically increasing margins and establishing LogiFlow as a key player in the European supply chain. This involved restructuring core processes, implementing advanced analytics, and building high-performing international teams. We achieved significant traction, growing revenue by 300% during my tenure while maintaining a strong focus on profitability. Currently, I’m leveraging my experience to advise companies facing similar scaling challenges, particularly those operating in complex international markets. I’m passionate about building robust, adaptable operational frameworks that drive sustainable value. I’m particularly interested in connecting with founders and investors focused on the future of logistics, supply chain technology, and platform businesses. If you’re building something ambitious and need a seasoned operator to help navigate the complexities of growth, I’d welcome a conversation.
